behavioral_notes.observation: THE BUY BACKBONE: stock.rule.action gains a 'buy' option, and each stock.warehouse gets a buy_pull_id rule on the 'purchase_stock.route_warehouse0_buy' route (created in _generate_global_route_rules_values, gated by buy_to_resupply). When a procurement hits a buy rule, _run_buy turns demand into purchasing: _get_matching_supplier picks a product.supplierinfo (orderpoint.supplier_id / supplierinfo_id / product._select_seller; if none and from_orderpoint it raises ProcurementException, else the dest move falls back to make_to_stock and _notify_responsible fires), groups procurements by _make_po_get_domain (partner/state=draft/picking_type/company/user/currency, plus partner.group_rfq day/week windowing), searches an existing draft purchase.order or creates one via _prepare_purchase_order as SUPERUSER_ID with_company, then merges procurements and either writes onto a candidate purchase.order.line (_update_purchase_order_line) or batch-creates new lines via _prepare_purchase_order_line_from_procurement, advancing po.date_order back by the supplier delay. _get_lead_days adds the vendor lead time + company.days_to_purchase to the cumulative replenishment delay (365-day penalty when no vendor). This whole reordering-rule/MTO -> RFQ pull is pure Python, invisible in metadata.

FORWARD DOCUMENT SIDE-EFFECT (PO -> receipt): button_approve calls super then _create_picking, which for each state='purchase' order with a consu product builds a stock.picking (vendor location -> _get_destination_location) via _prepare_picking as SUPERUSER_ID, generates moves from the lines (order_line._create_stock_moves -> purchase.order.line._prepare_stock_moves -> stock.move with purchase_line_id set), _action_confirm()/_action_assign() them, confirms forward push pickings (_get_impacted_pickings) and posts a mail.message_origin_link from the receipt back to the PO. picking_ids is a STORED compute from order_line.move_ids.picking_id; receipt_status/effective_date/is_shipped derive from picking states. button_cancel cascades: it cancels non-done moves & pickings, switches MTO destination moves to make_to_stock and recomputes their state, and logs a note on already-done receipts. None of this is declarative.

BACKWARD DOCUMENT SIDE-EFFECT (receipt -> billing control): _compute_qty_received_method flips qty_received_method to 'stock_moves' for consu products (selection_add), so _prepare_qty_received computes qty_received by summing DONE stock.move quantities on move_ids (UoM-converted HALF-UP), subtracting purchase returns and skipping double-counted dropship returns; this drives qty_to_invoice / invoice_status on the 'received quantities' billing policy. On a confirmed PO (state='purchase'), purchase.order.line.create and write re-run _create_or_update_picking (attaching/creating receipt moves to match the new ordered qty), write also re-prices non-done moves and triggers move._set_value() valuation when price_unit/product_qty/product_uom change, and decreasing an already-invoiced qty schedules a 'ask for a refund' activity on the vendor bill. Compute chain + side-effects invisible in metadata.

ANGLO-SAXON VALUATION HOOK (receipt <-> accounting): posting a vendor bill (account.move._post) creates extra COGS account.move.line price-difference entries via _stock_account_prepare_anglo_saxon_in_lines_vals for storable / standard-cost products already delivered, booking the gap between the PO/bill price and product standard_price to the category's property_price_difference_account_id; _stock_account_get_last_step_stock_moves links the bill to its done supplier-location stock.move records so valuation knows which receipts to value. Conversely the received stock.move values itself from the bill: stock.move._get_value_from_account_move walks purchase_line_id.invoice_lines (posted in_invoice minus in_refund) to value the layer, falling back before billing to _get_value_from_quotation using purchase.order.line._get_stock_move_price_unit. This closes the receipt->valuation->bill loop and is entirely code, not metadata.

RECEIPT RECONCILIATION LINK: stock.picking.purchase_id is a related field on move_ids.purchase_line_id.order_id, and stock.picking._action_done calls purchase_id.action_acknowledge() to signal receipt back to the PO. stock.move._action_synch_order auto-creates a zero-product_qty purchase.order.line (with qty_received set from the move and bypass_move_update context) for any picked product received on a PO-linked receipt that is not yet on the order, mirroring sale_stock's reverse back-fill; stock.lot._compute_purchase_order_ids traces a lot/serial to its originating purchase.order via done supplier moves. The load-bearing key is stock.move.purchase_line_id (indexed btree_not_null). All side-effects, invisible in metadata.

classification.rationale: purchase_stock is the procurement<->inventory bridge that makes purchase's abstract document chain physical: it owns one read-only SQL view (vendor.delay.report) and otherwise extends 27 stock/purchase/account models to wire them together. It realizes three legs of Procure-to-Pay — pull procurement (stock.rule._run_buy turns reordering-rule/MTO demand into RFQs on the warehouse 'buy' route), goods receipt (button_approve -> _create_picking creates the incoming stock.picking/stock.move), and billing-control/valuation (move-driven qty_received gates invoicing, and anglo-saxon entries value the receipt against the vendor bill). It is classified support / APQC 4.2 Procure Materials and Services (activity refs 4.2.3 schedule/order replenishment via _run_buy and the buy route, and 4.2.5 receive/inspect/store materials via _create_picking and qty_received): it provisions and accounts for physical inputs so the primary value-chain activities (stock, mrp, sale) can run, rather than producing or selling itself. value_model 'support' per Stabell & Fjeldstad — an inbound-logistics / firm-infrastructure enabler. (It depends stock_account + purchase and auto-installs, confirming its bridge role rather than a standalone capability.)

standard_capabilities: buy procurement route: reordering rules & make-to-order generate RFQs/POs automatically (_run_buy)
automatic incoming receipt (stock.picking) creation on PO approval
received quantity computed from done stock moves (invoice control on received qty)
vendor lead time + days-to-purchase folded into replenishment scheduling
PO grouping by vendor / day / week (group_rfq) when creating purchase orders
anglo-saxon stock valuation: receipt valued from the vendor bill, price-difference COGS entries on posting
drop-ship destination handling, MTO move chaining & cancel propagation
lot/serial traceability back to the purchase order; vendor on-time delay report
typical_fits: standard reordering-rule -> RFQ -> PO -> receipt -> bill replenishment
make-to-order purchase resupply from a confirmed sale/manufacturing demand
single- vs multi-step receptions (reception_steps) with backorders
anglo-saxon vs continental valuation toggled by company accounting setting
common_gaps: advanced 3-way match / billing-on-received tuning beyond the bundled policy
custom procurement/route rules or vendor-scoring beyond _get_matching_supplier
industry-specific receipt inspection / quality-control steps (separate quality module)
